name: ideal-school-platform
description: IDEAL SCHOOL payment, roles, salaries and finance platform

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2018 --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/app.js && javascript-obfuscator dist/app.js --output dist/app.js --compact true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --numbers-to-expressions true --string-array true --string-array-calls-transform true --string-array-calls-transform-threshold 1 --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-index-shift true --string-array-rotate true --string-array-shuffle true --string-array-threshold 1 --string-array-wrappers-count 2 --string-array-wrappers-chained-calls true --string-array-wrappers-type function --split-strings true --unicode-escape-sequence true && node scripts/clean-build.js
